images.title: Slimer at the Firehouse
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a finished wide 16:9 desktop wallpaper for a Ghostbusters theme. The attached screenshot is a STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE only, not a layout to reproduce. Keep its playful hand-drawn cartoon Slimer: bright ectoplasm green, orange eyes, huge joyful open mouth and purple tongue, bold clean black outlines, smooth cel shading and glossy highlights. Scene: inside the Ghostbusters firehouse at midnight, deep navy brick, arched moonlit window, warm orange hanging lamp, red firehouse doors and a small ghost trap on the floor with red-orange electrical energy. Slimer floats in the center-right above a luminous puddle, gesturing happily. Rich illustrated environmental detail and cinematic reflected neon green on wet concrete. Keep the left quarter darker and calmer for real desktop icons, with a clean dark upper edge for a real panel. Strong black/acid-green/blue palette, controlled orange and magenta accents. Wallpaper artwork ONLY: no desktop interface, no windows, no panels, no icons, no buttons, no lettering, no captions, no text watermark. High-resolution widescreen polished illustration.
